name: any-function-type-test-d439f10943/any-function-type-v.bal
spec_references: Subset restrictions / Import declarations: "Only following lang libraries with given methods/types are supported"; ballerina/lang.error lists only message, and ballerina/lang.value omits cloneReadOnly.
Subset restrictions / Invocations / Other invocation restrictions: "Method call syntax can be used for calling the following langlib functions:"; neither error:detail nor value:cloneReadOnly appears.
Supported language features (subset 10) / Expressions lists "Anonymous function expression", "Type cast expression" and "Type test expression".
reason: This mixed positive/runtime-negative case exercises broad function values, isolated function types, casts and narrowing, closures, function fields in records/classes/maps, unions, readonly arrays, and never-return subtyping. The expression and declaration categories cover much of that core functionality. However, e.detail() and arr.cloneReadOnly() require langlib methods outside the explicit supported lists, making the whole case a feature assessment regardless of potential defects in the supported function operations.
unsupported_constructs: ballerina/io import and io:println output harness are outside the listed libraries
test_design_notes: No @error markers occur; failed casts are deliberately trapped and asserted at runtime.
Nine main calls have matching @output () markers; no obvious marker mismatch appears.
The exact TypeCastError message assertion couples the test to diagnostic formatting. Unsupported library calls should be separated from core function-type coverage.
